messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel

message.content: I’m not sure I understand what you’re looking for. Train stations don’t usually have “pet‑friendly” policies—those apply to the trains themselves. If you’re asking whether the trains that stop at a particular station in Miami allow pets, that’s something Amtrak can confirm. If you’re looking for a station with pet‑friendly amenities (like a dog park nearby), I’d need more details. Could you clarify what you mean by a “pet‑friendly train station”?
